map.炎热指数为什么常高于气温？: Why is the heat index often higher than the air temperature?
map.高湿抑制出汗蒸发散热，体感比干热更热；公式已含 T 与 RH 的交叉项。: High humidity suppresses evaporative cooling by sweat, so it feels hotter than dry heat; the formula already contains the cross term of T and RH.
map.Heat Index 适用区间？: What range does the Heat Index apply to?
map.通常 T≥27°C 且 RH≥40% 才显著，低温高湿不报炎热指数。: Usually only T >=27 C and RH >=40% are significant; low temperature with high humidity does not report a heat index.
